Manipur Musician Beaten to Death in Delhi; Eight Arrested

A 54-year-old musician from Manipur was beaten to death in Delhi's Kilokari village on Monday. The incident occurred after the musician objected to a group of eight people creating a nuisance outside his home. All eight individuals have been arrested by the police.
